program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (can-move? board cells)
      (all? (lambda (p)
              (let ((nr (first p)) (nc (+ (second p) 1)))
                (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows board) (cols board))
                     (or (= (at board nr nc) 0) (member? (list nr nc) cells)))))
            cells))
    (define (shift-east cells)
      (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (+ (second p) 1))) cells))
    (define (slide board cells)
      (let loop ([cur cells])
        (if (can-move? board cur) (loop (shift-east cur)) cur)))
    (define walls (find-color g 9))
    (for/fold ([out (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) walls 9)])
              ([obj (in-list (filter (lambda (o) (not (= (obj-color o) 9))) (objects g 0)))])
      (let* ((board (paint-cells (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) walls 9)
                                 (obj-cells obj) (obj-color obj)))
             (moved (slide board (obj-cells obj))))
        (paint-cells out moved (obj-color obj))))))
